sections.h2: Where is Swatara Township, and what is it like to sell a house there?
sections.html:
Swatara Township is a Dauphin County township just south of Susquehanna Township in the Harrisburg area, and selling a house there means working with a township codes office, a private real estate tax collector and the county recorder. The township's municipal building is at 599 Eisenhower Boulevard in Harrisburg.

A 1799 court order split Lower Paxton Township in two and the southern half took the name Swatara, from Swatara Creek. The word is thought to come from a Susquehannock term meaning where we fed on eels. The township covers 15.5 square miles, with 13.05 of land and nearly 16 percent water along the Susquehanna River, and it holds Calver Island, which was added to the National Register in 2007.

sections.h2: What do the numbers say about Swatara Township?
sections.html:
The 2025 Census estimate is 27,936 residents, far above the 23,362 of 2010 and a hair above the 27,824 counted in 2020. Density is about 2,132 people per square mile.

Owners occupy 69.9 percent of homes, and the middle owned home was valued at $214,400 in the 2020 to 2024 survey. Rent runs $1,252 and household income $80,444. The township has 10,640 households of 2.47 people on average. Foreign-born residents make up 17.2 percent, and 24.7 percent of residents speak another language at home.

  • Named places: Bressler, Enhaut, Oberlin, Lawnton and Rutherford are census-designated places inside the township.
  • Retail and logistics: retail sales in 2022 reached $1,147,259,000, or $41,104 a head, while transportation and warehousing receipts were $509,815,000, the largest figure reported among the four places in this comparison.
  • Education: among adults, 87.5 percent finished high school and 28.5 percent have a bachelor's degree or more.

sections.h2: How does Swatara's codes office affect a sale?
sections.html:
Building and zoning permits come from the township's codes department, and Approved Code Services, Inc. does the plan reviews and construction inspections as the township's sole third-party agency. Property maintenance complaints and enforcement of the International Property Maintenance Code run through the same department.

Expect to need a building permit for new construction, additions and alterations. Routine maintenance, repairs and like-for-like equipment replacement generally need none. Stormwater management permits and quarterly waste fee exemption requests also go through the department.

When an inspector flags unpermitted work, phone the department at 717-564-2551 before replying; the office is open weekdays from 8 until 4:30. The township also runs a fall brush collection, and the 2026 round ran September 21 to 26, a handy moment to clear yard waste before showings.

sections.h2: Who collects real estate tax in Swatara, and what does closing cost in transfer tax?
sections.html:
Real estate tax is collected at a separate office, 6400A Chambers Hill Road in Harrisburg, and the municipal building does not accept those payments. The collector takes payment for the current year only. Tax certification requests go to that office at 717-832-4908.

Keystone Collections Group, with a Dauphin County office on Vartan Way, collects local services tax and earned income tax instead. Knowing the split helps when a title agent asks which office issues which certificate.

The county recorder's FAQ describes the 2 percent as divided among the state, the municipality and the school district. Recording takes place at the Dauphin County Courthouse, 101 Market Street, Harrisburg, where the deed index starts in 1785.

sections.h2: What schools and travel times will Swatara buyers weigh?
sections.html:
Central Dauphin School District covers Swatara Township together with Lower Paxton, Middle Paxton and West Hanover townships and the boroughs of Dauphin, Paxtang and Penbrook. Its schools include Swatara Middle School and Lawnton, Rutherford and Chambers Hill elementary schools. Within the county it is the biggest district, and statewide it ranks ninth.

Commutes average 20 minutes. The township reaches the Susquehanna River and is named for Swatara Creek, so a house near the water can raise questions that an interior lot does not. Ask your agent or a surveyor to confirm flood zone status if the property sits close to the creek or the river.

sections.h2: What does Swatara Township's local economy look like?
sections.html:
About 61.9 percent of residents 16 and older are in the labor force, and 61.5 percent of women in that age group are. Census business data for 2022 show $138,896,000 in accommodation and food service sales and $267,885,000 in health care and social assistance receipts, alongside the retail and warehousing figures above.

Household income of $80,444 sits next to a poverty rate of 8.3 percent, and 8.2 percent of residents under 65 lack health insurance. Veterans number 1,357. Buyers who commute to Harrisburg jobs, warehouse work or health care roles will compare this township's prices with the township to its north, so price your house with both in mind.

sections.h2: What should you collect before closing a Swatara Township sale?
sections.html:
A clean closing depends on a short list of documents, and most of them come from offices named on this page.

  • A tax certification from the township's tax collector, so the title agent sees what has been paid this year.
  • Your lender's payoff letter and a deed copy from the Dauphin County Recorder of Deeds.
  • Permit records for any addition, deck or alteration, from the Building and Codes Department.
  • Sewer and stormwater bills, which the township lists on a separate online payment page from real estate tax.
  • Receipts for work done since you bought, because buyers who finance will have an appraiser and an inspector look at condition.

Roughly 88.3 percent of people stayed at the same address for a year, so many owners have been in place a long time and may not have handled a sale recently. Children under 18 are 19.3 percent of the population and people 65 and over are 15.4 percent. Broadband reaches 93.0 percent of households.

sections.h2: Which routes work for a quick Swatara Township sale?
sections.html:
You can list with an agent, sell privately or sell straight to an investor or cash buyer. A listing may fetch the most but ties you to showings, repair requests and a lender's calendar.

  • Listing: fits a sound house when you can wait out financing and inspections.
  • Private sale: avoids a commission and leaves pricing and paperwork with you.
  • Direct purchase: cuts out financing and showings and lets you choose the closing day, at a price that reflects repairs.

On any route, line up a tax certification, a lender payoff letter and your deed copy. Have each buyer state in writing who pays the 2 percent transfer tax, because the deed will not record until it is paid.

faqs.q: Where does Swatara real estate tax get paid?
faqs.a: At the township's real estate tax collector at 6400A Chambers Hill Road, Harrisburg, or online through the link on the township's tax page. The municipal building does not accept real estate tax payments.

faqs.q: What does the transfer tax cost on a Swatara sale?
faqs.a: The Dauphin County recorder describes a 2 percent tax, with 1 percent to the state and one half percent each to the municipality and school district. On the $214,400 Census median value, that is $4,288.

faqs.q: Are permits needed for repairs before a Swatara sale?
faqs.a: New construction, additions and alterations generally need a building permit, while routine maintenance and replacement of existing equipment generally do not. Call the Building and Codes Department at 717-564-2551 if you are unsure.

faqs.q: Who collects Swatara's earned income tax?
faqs.a: Keystone Collections Group, which keeps a Dauphin County office on Vartan Way in Harrisburg. This is separate from the real estate tax collector.

faqs.q: What school district serves Swatara Township?
faqs.a: Central Dauphin School District. Its list of schools includes Swatara Middle School and elementary schools in Lawnton, Rutherford and Chambers Hill.
